A new year brings fresh routines, busy schedules, and the perfect excuse to reset your home’s comfort. At Dolan Design, we believe that feeling cozy starts with a dependable heating system and continues with the moments that make winter feel a little warmer.

And nothing brings that comfort together quite like a pot of homestyle Chicken & Dumplings simmering on the stove. It’s hearty, familiar, and exactly the kind of soul-soothing meal that makes January nights feel more inviting.

So while we help keep your home running smoothly this year, you can keep the comfort going in the kitchen. Here’s how to make this classic cold-weather favorite.

settings.html:
Prep Time
20 min
Cook Time
50 min
Total Time
1 hr 10 min
Servings
6–8

Ingredients

For the Stew:

  • 2 tbsp butter
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • ½ cup all-purpose flour (for dredging)
  • 1 whole chicken, cut into pieces
  • ½ cup carrots, diced
  • ½ cup celery, diced
  • 1 medium onion, diced
  • ½ cup frozen peas
  • 1 tsp kosher salt
  • 1 tsp pepper
  • ½ tsp ground thyme
  • ¼ tsp turmeric
  • 6 cups chicken broth
  • ½ cup heavy cream
  • 1½ cups half-and-half (divided)

For the Dumplings:

  • ½ cup all-purpose flour
  • ½ cup yellow cornmeal
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1 tsp kosher salt
  • ¾ cup half-and-half
  • 2 tbsp minced parsley (optional)

Instructions

  1. Brown the Chicken: Season chicken with salt and pepper, dredge in flour, and brown in butter and olive oil. Remove to a plate.
  2. Cook the Vegetables: Add onion, carrots, and celery to the same pot; cook 3–4 minutes. Add thyme, turmeric, and chicken broth. Stir well.
  3. Simmer: Add browned chicken back to the pot, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
  4. Make Dumpling Dough: Combine flour, cornmeal, baking powder, and salt. Stir in half-and-half until just combined.
  5. Shred the Chicken: Remove chicken from pot, shred with two forks, return to pot, and add heavy cream.
  6. Cook the Dumplings: Drop spoonfuls of dough into simmering stew. Add parsley if using. Cover halfway and cook 15 minutes.
  7. Serve: Add peas, adjust seasoning, and let rest 10 minutes before serving.
